item.title: [Unsupervised Learning] Ep 95: Modal CEO on the Future of Inference, the Chaos of the GPU Market & Origins of the Sandbox Bet
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:04 How much of, like, an an organized marketplaces compute these days versus, like, the Wild West?

Walking around, like, talking to people, trying to get GPUs, and meeting people in hotel lobbies, exchanging numbers. It's very far from an efficient market. I mean, some people are working on this.
